description: Paid: 0.001 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: Which IANA time zone contains this latitude and longitude, and what is its UTC offset at this instant? The IANA zone id(s) whose boundary contains one point (timezone-boundary-builder data, ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, via geo-tz) with UTC offset and abbreviation at an instant (default now; tzdata from the server runtime). One point per call. Boundaries can be wrong or disputed near borders and at sea; not legal-time, travel or navigation advice. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
